description: Cycle counts not recounted when variance exceeds tolerance and training records unavailable. Count results are not reliable.
Vendor bank detail changes approved by a single person. Dual approval control missing.
POs and payments over 5000 found without second approval. Approval matrix not enforced in the system.
Slow-moving stock provisions calculated manually without a documented policy and inconsistent month to month.
AP staff did not call back suppliers to verify requested bank detail changes.
Goods received without a matching PO line; receipts posted and invoices paid without three-way match.
Expense claims over 500 approved after the spend with no pre-approval.
New suppliers onboarded without registry, address or bank ownership checks.
Standard costs not updated for SKUs after supplier price changes, overstating stock value.
Cycle count schedule not followed for fast-moving aisles; counts done late.
Items found in wrong bin locations; system quantity correct but location codes wrong.
Slow-stock provision calculated in a spreadsheet with manual overrides and no review evidence.
